map.上传音频，在波形上拖选片段，试听后导出为 WAV。纯本地处理，文件不会上传。: Upload audio, drag to select a segment on the waveform, preview it, then export as WAV. Processing is fully local and the file is never uploaded.
map.为视频剪辑或课件提取某句台词、某段音效，按波形精确定位起止点。: Extract a particular line of dialogue or a sound effect for video editing or courseware, locating the exact start and end points on the waveform.
map.从长录音中截取一段精彩片段或去头尾静音，生成可直接使用的短音频。: Cut a highlight clip out of a long recording, or strip the leading and trailing silence, to produce a short clip ready to use.
map.剪切后为什么开头有咔哒一声？: Why is there a click at the start after trimming?
map.当裁剪点落在波形非零位置，信号被硬切断会形成不连续的跳变产生爆音。在裁剪边界加极: When a cut lands where the waveform is non-zero, hard-slicing the signal creates a discontinuity that produces a click. A very short fade in and out at the cut boundary (a few milliseconds) removes it; this tool applies that automatically when you drag-select on the waveform and export.
map.把一首曲子裁成铃声或铃声素材，避免手动再转码。: Cut a track down to a ringtone or ringtone clip without re-encoding by hand.
map.纯按采样点截取是无损的（非重编码），只要导出格式与原精度一致（如都导出 WAV）: Cutting purely at sample points is lossless (no re-encoding). As long as the export format matches the original precision (for example both as WAV), there is no second lossy pass; compression loss only appears if you export to a lossy format.
map.：一段 44100Hz 立体声音频，若要截取 30.000 秒到 35.250: : for a 44100 Hz stereo track, cutting from 30.000 s to 35.250 s corresponds to sample indices from 44100 x 30 = 1,323,000 to 44100 x 35.25 = 1,554,225 (per channel). A 5-10 ms linear fade at the cut boundary is advised so the discontinuity does not produce a click at the start or end. Exporting WAV is a non-destructive cut that keeps the original sample precision.
